name: PitchBook
description: PitchBook is a financial-data and research platform for private and public companies, deals, investors, funds, people, limited partners, service providers, markets, valuations, and venture-capital and private-equity workflows.
agentUseSummary: PitchBook offers a REST API through its separately licensed Direct Data product, but Relay cannot offer Connect from an ordinary PitchBook Platform subscription. PitchBook must approve a standalone API and data-license agreement defining the authentication token, licensed endpoints and fields, AI/agent processing, storage, attribution, usage, and output rights before bounded Relay tools can be implemented or published.

capabilities.label: Read licensed entities
capabilities.description: After PitchBook approval, retrieve small allowlisted profiles and licensed fields for companies, investors, funds, people, limited partners, and service providers by validated identifier.

capabilities.label: Read licensed deal data
capabilities.description: After PitchBook approval, retrieve small allowlisted financing and deal details through the exact endpoints and field package granted in the Direct Data Order.

blocked.label: Connect before Direct Data approval
blocked.description: No PitchBook connection or API call may run until PitchBook executes a Direct Data API agreement for Relay and supplies the approved authentication, endpoints, fields, limits, and environments.

blocked.label: Block platform credentials and scraping
blocked.description: PitchBook Platform usernames, passwords, SSO sessions, MFA codes, cookies, browser or mobile automation, scraping, reverse-engineered endpoints, copied tokens, and ordinary subscription access are unavailable as API substitutes.

blocked.label: Block unlicensed data and AI use
blocked.description: Uncontracted entities, fields, predictions, searches, bulk extraction, CRM or database loading, machine learning, neural networks, predictive analytics, external AI/LLM processing, caching, persistence, and derived substitutes are unavailable.

blocked.label: Block redistribution and raw access
blocked.description: Transfers, resale, display, disclosure, publishing, redistribution, external sharing, unapproved reports, arbitrary filters, pagination, endpoints, retries, raw REST, browser, CLI, or other unrestricted access are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: PitchBook Direct Data review pending
approvalProfiles.description: All actions remain unavailable until PitchBook approves Relay's Direct Data API contract, authentication, datasets, fields, AI/agent use, storage, output, attribution, and rate boundaries.

runtimeSupport.description: A bounded Direct Data wrapper can be mounted after PitchBook contract approval; no OpenClaw tools are callable while the API and data license are pending.
A bounded Direct Data wrapper can be mounted after PitchBook contract approval; no Hermes tools are callable while the API and data license are pending.

providerSetup.blocker: PitchBook states that its API is a separate Direct Data offering requiring a standalone contract and direct setup with its team. The public help page identifies api.pitchbook.com and says access is established through an API key or authentication token, but it does not publish the complete credential lifecycle, endpoint schemas, licensed field package, limits, or revocation contract. PitchBook's default terms restrict use to internal business operations and prohibit scraping, systematic acquisition, third-party database/CRM use, external distribution, and machine-learning or AI processing unless an applicable Order grants broader rights. Relay has no reviewed Direct Data Order or test entitlement.
providerSetup.nextAction: PitchBook Direct Data must approve Relay's use case and execute an Order defining licensed entities, endpoints, fields, AI/agent processing, internal users, output, attribution, CRM/database, retention, deletion, redistribution, rate, audit, provider-mark, authentication, rotation, revocation, staging, and production rights. After receiving the approved API contract and test credential, implement only small identifier-bound entity and deal reads and verify field reduction, entitlements, attribution, limits, disconnect, credential rotation, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: PitchBook states that its REST API is a separate offering from the Platform, requires a standalone contract, uses api.pitchbook.com, offers relational entity and deal endpoints, and is established by its Direct Data team through an API key or authentication token.
PitchBook markets Direct Data API access for contract-specific company, deal, investor, fund, person, limited-partner, and service-provider data integrated into customer systems.
PitchBook describes separately purchased API, data-feed, CRM, and AI-workflow data solutions in which customers choose and pay for the data they need.

PitchBook's default terms make broader rights dependent on an Order and restrict credentials, systematic access, scraping, redistribution, third-party databases and CRMs, and machine-learning or AI use.
PitchBook publishes its current privacy policy for Platform, application, service, support, compliance, billing, and personal-data processing.
